description: Gamma-gamma and annihilation coincidence probabilities for true-coincidence summing corrections, computed from ENSDF decay schemes
convention: per transition: br, g = [[keV, gammas per decay of the transition]], c = [[i, j, P(j emitted | i emitted)]], i above j in the cascade; ann = [[i, P(beta+ in the same decay | i emitted)]] (two 511 keV photons per beta+), ann_unresolved = beta+ feeding inconsistent; no X-ray coincidences

source.project: ENSDF via IAEA LiveChart of Nuclides https://nds.iaea.org/relnsd/v1/data (fields=decay_rads, rad_types=g, bp)
